scope: the parameter set a valve-train dynamics run of this head needs, in the tool assigned by docs/TOOLCHAIN.md (MuJoCo, witness in params/dynamics-witness.json) or in the one-mass model of the M64 head. Every value is null: none is known for this head. Nothing here is a value, a hypothesis or a study assumption
rule: an entry leaves null only with a source: a supplier specification or drawing of the identified head, or a contributed measurement admitted under decision 0019. Published values of other heads are not entries of this one: the production 930 Turbo lifts, timing and lobe dimensions in docs/research/935-head-published-data-20261116/findings.json belong to another engine. The witness inputs of params/dynamics-witness-acceptance.json are round numbers for closed forms, not values of this head

blockers.698: #698: valve, seat and guide geometry of the identified head and which valve is the inlet. Waits on #692 (identify the specimen) and on a supplier specification or a contributed measurement
blockers.0019: docs/decisions/0019-accept-contributed-measurements.md: the project measures nothing itself and pays nobody to measure; a contributed measurement needs its capture protocol, an explicit licence, an identified specimen and a review independent of the contributor. No contributor is named and none has been asked
blockers.692: #692: identify the specimen and the engine it belongs to

load_case.note: written for the 993; each of its required inputs maps to the entries named in lc_input below

valves.valve_y_minus: the valve axis fitted on the y-minus flange side (params/feature-fits.json); role unknown
valves.valve_y_plus: the valve axis fitted on the y-plus flange side (params/feature-fits.json); role unknown

role.note: H09 assumes valve_y_minus is the inlet for one thermal screen only; that assumption is not an entry here

cam_lift_curve.unit: mm of cam lift against degrees of camshaft angle
cam_lift_curve.note: a measured cam card with its reference lift and lash, or the supplier's lift table

cam_timing_centreline.unit: crank degrees after top dead centre

valve_head_diameter.note: the fitted seat and throat diameters of params/feature-fits.json are nominal fits on a scan, not the valve

valve_stem_diameter.note: the fitted guide bore is 8.51 mm, a nominal fit on a scan; the production 930 stem does not fit it

engine_speed_cases.note: a speed range declared by the owner makes a screen; the engine's limit needs a source

how_the_tool_takes_them: the assigned tool takes a cam as its lift law at the valve (cam lift times the rocker ratio, after lash) on a translating body, and a rocker as a reduced mass or a translating body of its own: its contact on a turning cam failed the witness (params/dynamics-witness-rotating-cam.json)
first_steps_once_held: fill the entries with their sources, every value with its instrument and uncertainty or its document
rerun the dynamics witness in the locked environment
spring margin and float speed over the declared speeds, then the valve-to-valve and valve-to-plug clearances on the fitted axes at full lift
report the result as a sensitivity study until a bench trace exists
